```gherkin
Feature: Alarms

  Scenario: Battery failure alarm has high priority
    Given the system is in normal operation
    When the battery fails
    Then the "battery failure" alarm is triggered with high priority

  Scenario: System can sense temperature of heating elements
    Given the system is in normal operation
    When the blower motor temperature is 50°C
    Then the system can sense the temperature of the blower motor
    And the system can sense the temperature of the battery cell

  Scenario: GUI can read temperature sensors
    Given the system is in normal operation
    When the blower motor temperature is 50°C
    Then the GUI can read the temperature of the blower motor
    And the GUI can read the temperature of the blower power management system
    And the GUI can read the temperature of the battery cell

  Scenario: Blower motor temperature too high alarm
    Given the system is in normal operation
    When the blower motor temperature is 70°C
    And the user-specified threshold is 65°C
    Then the "blower motor temperature too high" alarm is triggered

  Scenario: Blower power system temperature too high alarm
    Given the system is in normal operation
    When the blower power system temperature is 80°C
    And the user-specified threshold is 75°C
    Then the "blower power system temperature too high" alarm is triggered

  Scenario: Battery temperature too high alarm
    Given the system is in normal operation
    When the battery temperature is 90°C
    And the user-specified threshold is 85°C
    Then the "battery temperature too high" alarm is triggered

  Scenario: Automatic safety action for blower power system temperature
    Given the system is in normal operation
    When the blower power system temperature is 90°C
    And the user-specified threshold is 85°C
    Then the system automatically invokes a safety action

  Scenario: Automatic safety action for battery temperature
    Given the system is in normal operation
    When the battery temperature is 90°C
    And the user-specified threshold is 85°C
    Then the system automatically invokes a safety action

  Scenario Outline: Alarms with user-specified thresholds
    Given the system is in normal operation
    When the blower motor temperature is <temperature>
    And the user-specified threshold is <threshold>
    Then the "blower motor temperature too high" alarm is triggered
    Examples:
      | temperature | threshold |
      | 60°C        | 55°C      |
      | 70°C        | 65°C      |
      | 80°C        | 75°C      |

  Scenario Outline: Alarms with user-specified thresholds
    Given the system is in normal operation
    When the blower power system temperature is <temperature>
    And the user-specified threshold is <threshold>
    Then the "blower power system temperature too high" alarm is triggered
    Examples:
      | temperature | threshold |
      | 60°C        | 55°C      |
      | 70°C        | 65°C      |
      | 80°C        | 75°C      |

  Scenario Outline: Alarms with user-specified thresholds
    Given the system is in normal operation
    When the battery temperature is <temperature>
    And the user-specified threshold is <threshold>
    Then the "battery temperature too high" alarm is triggered
    Examples:
      | temperature | threshold |
      | 60°C        | 55°C      |
      | 70°C        | 65°C      |
      | 80°C        | 75°C      |
```
